name: tern-todo
summary: Expose the active interactive Glitch plan to the native Tern TODO view.
way_in: Read README.md and CONTRACT.md when writing or maintaining the canonical checkpoint block. Use /glitch-execute in Claude Code or $glitch-execute in Codex with one explicit plan path. Configured native hooks publish the plan. For a deliberately resumed legacy plan, add the agreed block through the authorized plan workflow and run the exact adopt command from the hook once. See README.md for other interactive agents. Fleet and BWPM work are outside scope.
